description: Returns the NFL's official game-day inactives for a week (default the newest week published), by team, with gsis, espn, sleeper and pfr ids. Published after the games, usually days later. Use it for audits and backtesting, not as a pre-kickoff list (teams_published vs teams_played shows how complete the week is). Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.
season.title: Season

team.description: Only this team. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

week.description: Week 1-22 (19+ are playoffs). Default: the newest week with inactives published.
week.title: Week

name: get_inactives

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

inactives.description: Inactive players by team, with gsis, espn, sleeper and pfr ids.

loaded_at.description: When GridIron last loaded the data.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

teams_played.description: Teams whose game that week is final; the week is complete when they match.

teams_published.description: Teams with inactives published for the week so far.

title: Official game-day inactives
